description:
Get the next pair of entities to evaluate.

Strategies: adaptive (default), swiss, balanced, random,
uncertainty, explore, information_gain -- the same selection the
web app uses. Left/right order is randomised, and the pair comes
with no rating or predicted winner (match_quality is closeness
only), so show it to the voter as-is.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_get_matchup
